1.0.1.changeLog: Updated to remain compatible with the latest Microsoft changes. No functional changes. Resolves the mismatch status.

1.1.0.changeLog: Microsoft added new default properties to Conditional Access policies: conditions.applications.includeAgentActions (empty list) and sessionControls.humanApproval (not configured). Added them to this policy so deployed policies no longer show a mismatch that Fix Drift cannot resolve. Renamed the policy from "CA010: Require password change for high-risk users" to "CA010: Require risk remediation for high-risk users" to follow Microsoft's updated naming for the user risk remediation policy. Grant controls updated to match Microsoft's "Require risk remediation for high-risk users" template: the "Require multifactor authentication" and "Require password change" controls are replaced by "Require risk remediation" (riskRemediation) with the built-in "Multifactor authentication" authentication strength. Sign-in frequency remains "Every time". Risk remediation is not supported for guest and external users.
